thread:
lucia_acme: Hi — invoice #INV-2026-034 is still charging VAT. We submitted our EU VAT ID (DE123456789) and resale cert yesterday but finance insists on a PO. VIES lookup shows valid. Can you apply reverse charge?

anna_support: Sorry for the trouble, lucia. Can you paste the VAT ID as it appears on your certificate and confirm the PO number? I can kick off manual VIES recheck.

lucia_acme: VAT ID on file: DE 123456789 (with a space). PO is PO-77854, procurement already uploaded a PO but maybe it didn't link.

billing-bot: Automated VIES check started for VAT=DE123456789
billing-bot: VIES response: status=valid, name=ACME GmbH, address=München, note=name_mismatch

anna_support: Looks like VIES accepted the ID but flagged a name mismatch. That shouldn't block reverse charge eligibility. I'm escalating to billing.

mike_billing: @anna_support adding context — our billing flow requires either: (1) PO linked to account + resale cert or (2) VAT ID verified + signed resale cert. If VIES returns name_mismatch we still accept if customer provides signed resale cert and PO or an explicit billing override.

anna_support: Repro steps I ran:
```bash
# sample call we use
curl -s "https://vies.example/api/check?country=DE&vat=123456789" -H "X-Request-ID: req-1799123456"
# response: {"countryCode":"DE","vat":"123456789","valid":true,"name":"ACME GMBH","address":"Muenchen","note":"name_mismatch"}
```

jaroslav_engineer: FWIW there's a normalization quirk in our VIES client where spaces or lower/upper case in the country code can change lookup path. It doesn't change validity, but our linker that associates PO->invoice is strict about exact VAT string. We should normalize globally. I'll open a PR but won't ship until EOW.

mike_billing: For now I can do a manual override if we get: 1) upload of signed resale_cert.pdf and 2) PO number confirmation in thread. If you can attach the cert I'll process.

lucia_acme: Uploaded `resale_cert.pdf` and confirmed PO-77854. Thanks.

mike_billing: Done — I applied reverse charge to INV-2026-034 and issued credit memo CM-2026-89. You should see the updated invoice in the billing portal. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-034 credited (CM-2026-89). Triggered refund flow for amount 3,420.00 EUR. Reference: tx-892345.

dana_escalations: Marking resolved but follow-up: engineering to add VAT normalization and billing to add heuristic to accept VIES name_mismatch when PO present. Filed ticket #INFR-522.

lucia_acme: Confirmed, received credit. Thanks everyone! :pray:
